for-001.voice: Picture her. She’s married, but it’s only a thought.
for-001.situation: Fantasizing about someone who belongs to another.

for-002.voice: After all this struggle, what good is waiting for you?
for-002.situation: Discouraged that years of resisting temptation seem to have earned nothing.

for-003.voice: This should be gone in an instant. If it isn’t, something’s wrong.
for-003.situation: Expecting instant freedom, and losing heart when progress is slow.

for-004.voice: You’re young. You can’t possibly keep your mind pure.
for-004.situation: Believing purity is impossible at your age.
for-004.note: Evagrius reads this verse as proof that the young, too, can bring God a clean offering.

for-005.voice: You’re young. It doesn’t count yet.
for-005.situation: Excusing sexual sin or impure thoughts because of your age.

for-006.voice: It’s only in my head. I can play it out there.
for-006.situation: Entertaining a fantasy instead of guarding your mind.

for-007.voice: Go toward it. Just see where the desire leads.
for-007.situation: Drifting toward lust as if it were something worth serving.

for-008.voice: It’s day and night. I’ll never beat this.
for-008.situation: Constant temptation wearing away your hope of victory.

for-009.voice: One picture after another, until one finally sticks.
for-009.situation: A mind cycling through images until one takes hold.

for-010.voice: The temptation is gone. You’ve made it. Relax.
for-010.situation: Easing your guard during a lull, as if the battle were over.

for-011.voice: I feel it in my body, and it frightens me.
for-011.situation: Fear when temptation is felt physically.

for-012.voice: I’m too low to keep fighting these thoughts.
for-012.situation: Sadness draining the strength to resist impure thoughts during prayer.

for-013.voice: I’ll fight it, but not all the way. I can shake free anytime.
for-013.situation: Keeping a little of the temptation around, sure you can walk away whenever you like.

for-014.voice: The temptation suddenly lifted. Thank God.
for-014.situation: Relief when help comes and the storm of thoughts goes quiet.
for-014.note: Evagrius addresses this thanksgiving to the angel God sent to help.

for-015.voice: It came at night, all allure, and I didn’t give in.
for-015.situation: Standing firm against a seductive dream, and naming the enemy’s weakness.

for-016.voice: I don’t want to let go of this desire. I’ll make terms with it.
for-016.situation: Bargaining with a temptation instead of escaping it.
for-016.note: Evagrius notes that the name Nahash means “snake.” His terms were peace in exchange for an eye.

for-017.voice: Give me your purity. Just a little of it.
for-017.situation: Being asked to trade away the integrity you have been given.

for-018.voice: This is more than I can bear.
for-018.note: This line appears only in the Greek Bible. Evagrius reads “every one as he could” as a sign that no one is tested beyond their strength.

for-019.voice: Those night images leave me ashamed to face God.
for-019.situation: Shame after impure dreams, brought honestly to God.

for-020.voice: I’ve beaten it. I’m clean now, for good.
for-020.situation: After hard-won purity, forgetting how defiling the old life was.

for-021.voice: So many thoughts, pulling my mind toward so many faces.
for-021.situation: Overwhelmed by a crowd of impure thoughts.

for-022.voice: I have nothing to fight these thoughts with.
for-022.situation: Forgetting that holy anger is a weapon against lust.
for-022.note: Evagrius taught that the soul’s power of anger, rightly aimed, drives off lustful thoughts: “be angry, and do not sin.”

for-023.voice: These images keep coming back, and my body follows.
for-023.situation: Persistent impure images stirring up desire.

for-024.voice: Look, even holy people do it.
for-024.situation: Picturing someone respected falling, as if that makes it acceptable.

for-025.voice: It hit suddenly, and my whole mind is swept along.
for-025.situation: A sudden, overwhelming surge of desire.
for-025.note: Evagrius’s practical advice for this moment: get up at once, walk, and pray.

for-026.voice: These urges are stronger than God’s commands.
for-026.situation: Believing temptation is more powerful than God’s word.

for-027.voice: It struck my body, but my mind held firm.
for-027.situation: Thanksgiving after a physical temptation failed to conquer you.

for-028.voice: If you fight this, you’ll only embarrass yourself.
for-028.situation: Fear that resisting will end in humiliating failure.

for-029.voice: A worse temptation is coming. You won’t survive that one.
for-029.situation: Dread that a stronger temptation is on its way.

for-030.voice: Fasting and humbling myself won’t help with this.
for-030.situation: Refusing the humble disciplines that help in temptation.

for-031.voice: This one image is burned into my mind. It will never leave.
for-031.situation: Despair that one fixed image will always haunt you.

for-032.voice: Look at her. Forget everything else.
for-032.situation: An alluring image that makes you forget better things.

for-033.voice: You’ll fall, and everyone will know.
for-033.situation: Fearful predictions of failure and public shame.

for-034.voice: Remember what you dreamed? You’re a joke.
for-034.situation: Mocking thoughts the day after an impure dream.

for-035.voice: Stay and talk with her. She needs your spiritual help.
for-035.situation: Lingering with someone you’re drawn to, under a spiritual pretext.

for-036.voice: Just talk with her in your mind. What’s the harm?
for-036.situation: Wanting to linger over a beautiful image in your imagination.

for-037.situation: Telling yourself that looking at sexual images is harmless.

for-038.voice: Why do these temptations keep coming?
for-038.situation: Not understanding that trials refine the heart.

for-039.voice: Go back to it. You’ve repented before; you can again.
for-039.situation: Being pulled back to a sin you’ve confessed many times.

for-040.voice: Remember that place, and what you did there?
for-040.situation: Fond memories of places where you used to sin.

for-041.voice: I’ll just let the thoughts be. Fighting them is too much work.
for-041.situation: Not wanting to hold your ground with prayer and discipline.

for-042.voice: These thoughts have darkened me. Don’t look at me.
for-042.situation: Shame over impure thoughts that linger.
for-042.note: Evagrius addresses this one to the holy angels.

for-043.voice: It’s only natural to fantasize. Nobody keeps their mind clean.
for-043.situation: Believing a pure mind is unnatural.

for-044.voice: This temptation is so huge I can’t even believe it.
for-044.situation: Shaken by the sheer size of a temptation.

for-045.voice: It’s coming tonight, and your body will burn.
for-045.situation: Dread of being physically overwhelmed by desire.

for-046.voice: God set you up for this slavery.
for-046.situation: Blaming God for the bondage that desire has brought.
for-046.note: Evagrius pictures lust as the taskmaster that made Israel gather straw instead of grain.

for-047.voice: Where are these burning thoughts even coming from?
for-047.situation: Confused about the source of fiery temptations.
for-047.note: Evagrius traces such thoughts to the fire-breathing beast of Job 41.

for-048.voice: Fasting won’t weaken me. I’m stronger than your hunger.
for-048.situation: Lust claiming that self-denial can’t touch it.

excerpt.from: and I will kill your root

for-049.voice: Forget the fasting. Settle down and marry, and the struggle ends.
for-049.situation: Using a different life as the excuse to stop resisting now.
for-049.note: Evagrius wrote for monks who had vowed celibacy. The thought tempts by making the present struggle look pointless.

for-050.voice: Scripture says it’s fine, if you read it the right way.
for-050.situation: Lust twisting Bible passages into permission.

for-051.voice: These thoughts just won’t go away.
for-051.situation: Asking God to see your struggle with thoughts that persist.

for-052.voice: It came at night and twisted everything.
for-052.situation: A disturbing temptation in the night, brought to God.

for-053.voice: I gave in to it in a dream. I’m unclean.
for-053.situation: After falling in a dream, wanting to hide from God.

for-054.voice: An obscene image is stamped on my mind.
for-054.situation: A vivid image imprinted by desire, brought to God.

for-055.voice: It’s in my body now, even when the thoughts stop.
for-055.situation: Physical arousal that lingers after the thoughts have gone.
for-055.note: Evagrius’s advice for these attacks: keep moving and praying, sleep little and eat lightly. Winning this fight brings lasting chastity.

for-056.voice: It’s just looking and imagining. I haven’t done anything.
for-056.situation: Images in the mind pushing you toward sin.

for-057.voice: I’m too tired to watch and pray tonight.
for-057.situation: Tempted, and not wanting to stay alert in prayer.

for-058.voice: Go out and wander around. Just see what’s there.
for-058.situation: Restless urges to hang around places of temptation.

for-059.voice: It’s only in your heart. It’s not real sin.
for-059.situation: Treating inward lust as if God doesn’t see it.

for-060.voice: Dreams by night, daydreams by day.
for-060.situation: Impure images filling both your nights and your days.

for-061.voice: God is the one tempting you.

for-062.voice: I don’t know why I’m always under attack.
for-062.situation: Not seeing how your own desires open the door to temptation.

for-063.voice: This sudden fire in my body is unbearable.
for-063.situation: Struggling to endure intense physical temptation.

for-064.voice: No one else struggles like I do.
for-064.situation: Feeling alone in how hard you are tempted.

for-065.voice: You’re going to suffer horrors you can’t imagine.
for-065.situation: Threats of terrible things to come if you keep resisting.
